title: Adopt programmatic aisle update helper at default and auto-detect write sites
description: Update the two programmatic aisle assignment paths in AddItemSheet so last-used defaulting and auto-detect both route their `selectedAisle` writes through the suppression helper, preserving existing behavioral rules.
acceptance_criteria: `applyLastUsedAisleDefault` performs its `selectedAisle` write inside the programmatic-update helper.
`performAutoDetect` performs its successful `selectedAisle` write inside the programmatic-update helper.
Programmatic updates do not flip the manual-selection flag.
Auto-detect still sets its success cue when it applies a detected aisle.

handoff_summary.completed: Both programmatic aisle write sites (`applyLastUsedAisleDefault` and `performAutoDetect`) already route through `setAisleProgrammatically`. The `onChange(of: selectedAisle)` guard suppresses `isAisleManuallySelected` for programmatic updates. `performAutoDetect` still sets `isAutoDetected = true` after the helper call.
handoff_summary.next_action: Proceed to tester agent for validation.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Dependency bead B-b13cb43f already implemented both call-site adoptions alongside the helper infrastructure. This bead's implementation was a no-op.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should verify that picker interaction sets `isAisleManuallySelected`, that `applyLastUsedAisleDefault` and `performAutoDetect` do not flip that flag, and that `isAutoDetected` is set by a successful auto-detect.

execution_history.summary: All acceptance criteria already satisfied. B-b13cb43f (commit 3e4b0c97) went beyond its own scope and adopted `setAisleProgrammatically` at both `applyLastUsedAisleDefault` and `performAutoDetect`, as well as adding the `onChange` guard and the helper itself. No code changes needed for this bead.
